name: bandit.r010_m069_setup_origin_route_bridge_mcw

evidence_contract.claim: setup establishes authoritative origin (160,39,0) and the ordinary route consumer constructs a nonempty canonical route back to (162,36,0)
evidence_contract.preconditions_and_interventions: fixture installation only; typed player_view_seen_omt and origin transforms are setup-only and grant no gameplay credit
evidence_contract.causal_boundary: stop after the reverse route preview; no travel, wait, ecology edit, report, response, shakedown, ingestion, query, or selected downstream launch
evidence_contract.real_code_path: ordinary overmap input -> CHOOSE_DESTINATION -> native overmap route construction
evidence_contract.expected_transition: setup origin -> nonempty route back to observer OMT
evidence_contract.pass_fail_rule: green only when authoritative origin, canonical reverse route, grants_gameplay_proof=false, and cleanup are all present
